priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect at all times and use Mirror Image before combat begins.
Pre-cast Meteor (if Sunfury Execution is talented) followed by a hard-cast Pyroblast to start the encounter.
Always activate Combustion while finishing a hard-cast (Fireball, Scorch, or Pyroclasm Pyroblast) so it benefits from the buff.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities once Combustion is active.
Spend Hot Streak procs immediately on instant Pyroblasts during both Combustion and filler phases.
Use Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak, ensuring you don't cap charges and prioritizing its use during Combustion.
Cast Meteor during Combustion, ideally after your initial hard-cast has landed.
During Combustion, hard-cast Pyroblast if the Pyroclasm buff is active and the cast will complete before Combustion ends.
Use Scorch as your primary filler during Combustion if the target is below 30% health (Sunfury/Scald logic).
Outside of Combustion, hard-cast Pyroblast only if Pyroclasm is at 2 stacks or if Combustion has more than 12 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use Scorch whenever Heat Shimmer procs for a guaranteed crit and movement flexibility.
Cast Meteor on cooldown outside of Combustion if the Combustion cooldown is longer than 12 seconds.
Use Scorch as your primary filler instead of Fireball when the target is below 30% health if Scald is talented.
Use Fireball as your main filler to generate Heating Up procs when above 30% health or outside of execution windows.
Avoid using Fire Blast if you already have a Hot Streak proc to prevent wasting the charge.
